title: Reduce Municipal Water Leakage in Distribution Networks
raw_description: Our municipal distribution pipes leak silently underground and we only find out when a road floods or citizen complaints spike. We need real-time leak detection and pressure monitoring.

statement_json.problem: High non-revenue water loss caused by undetected pipeline leakages across municipal distribution zones.
statement_json.background: Aging underground water pipeline infrastructure in District A suffers from recurring pressure drops and physical fractures.
statement_json.existing_system: Manual acoustic stick inspections conducted reactively after citizen complaints or surface flooding.
statement_json.identified_gap: Absence of real-time continuous telemetry and predictive acoustic anomaly monitoring.
statement_json.desired_solution: Deploy IoT sensor nodes and AI-driven pressure and acoustic analytics to pinpoint leaks within 6 hours.
statement_json.target_users: Municipal water supply engineers, field maintenance crews, and district administration.
statement_json.technical_requirements: Battery-powered acoustic/pressure sensors, cellular/LoRaWAN telemetry, GIS map dashboard, REST APIs.
statement_json.constraints: Sensors must fit existing valve chambers without interrupting municipal water supply during deployment.
statement_json.budget: ₹10,00,000 all-inclusive for hardware, cloud infrastructure, and 90-day pilot validation.
statement_json.timeline: 90 calendar days across 4 phased milestone deliveries.
statement_json.expected_outcomes: Reduction in non-revenue water loss from 30% to under 20% across the pilot distribution zone.
statement_json.kpis: Leak detection time < 6 hrs; water wastage <= 20%; uptime >= 95%; cost per km <= ₹25,000.
statement_json.eligibility_requirements: DPIIT-recognized startup with ISO 9001:2015 certification and at least 2 years operational track record.
statement_json.data_requirements: Daily pressure and acoustic time-series logs exported securely in CSV/JSON format.
statement_json.security_requirements: End-to-end encrypted telemetry transmission, role-based access control, and adherence to municipal data guidelines.

title: AI-Based Hospital OPD Queue and Patient Triage Management
raw_description: District civil hospitals face severe overcrowding and long OPD waiting queues leading to patient dissatisfaction and delayed critical care triage.

statement_json.problem: Unmanaged patient influx causing bottlenecks at civil hospital OPD registration and consultation counters.
statement_json.background: Peak morning arrivals overwhelm hospital staff, causing 2-3 hour wait times and delayed emergency identification.
statement_json.existing_system: Physical paper tokens issued manually at single registration window.
statement_json.identified_gap: No dynamic queue balancing, priority triage categorisation, or digital slot allocation.
statement_json.desired_solution: AI-assisted digital queue token management system with automated priority triage and SMS/kiosk notifications.
statement_json.target_users: OPD patients, medical officers, nursing staff, and hospital administrators.
statement_json.technical_requirements: Cloud-hosted triage engine, multilingual kiosk interface, SMS gateway integration, ABDM health ID compliance.
statement_json.constraints: Must work reliably during internet intermittent periods with local offline queue fallback.
statement_json.budget: ₹7,50,000 for software deployment, kiosk setup, and 120-day pilot testing.
statement_json.expected_outcomes: Average wait times reduced below 45 minutes and high-risk patients triaged within 10 minutes.
statement_json.kpis: Average wait time <= 45 min; triage accuracy >= 90%; throughput >= 650 patients/day.
statement_json.eligibility_requirements: DPIIT-registered healthtech startup with ISO 27001 certification and experience in clinical workflow software.
statement_json.data_requirements: Anonymized patient queue timestamps and triage priority categorizations.
statement_json.security_requirements: Strict patient data confidentiality, DISHA/ABDM healthcare security compliance, and encrypted storage.

title: Smart Municipal Waste Collection Fleet Route Optimisation
raw_description: Inefficient municipal waste vehicle routing results in missed collection bins, high fuel consumption, and overflowing community dumpsters.

statement_json.problem: Unoptimized static garbage truck routes causing delayed collections and excessive fuel expenditures.
statement_json.background: Solid waste collection across 15 municipal wards currently runs on rigid legacy timetables regardless of bin fill levels.
statement_json.existing_system: Fixed daily truck rounds with manual paper logbooks.
statement_json.identified_gap: Lack of dynamic fill-level monitoring and automated GPS route optimization based on real-time bin status.
statement_json.desired_solution: Ultrasonic bin level sensors combined with GPS vehicle telematics and dynamic route dispatch engine.
statement_json.target_users: Sanitation supervisors, truck drivers, ward corporators, and municipal health officers.
statement_json.technical_requirements: Ruggedized ultrasonic bin sensors, GPS vehicle trackers, dynamic routing algorithm, driver mobile app.
statement_json.constraints: Sensor enclosures must be IP67 rated and vandal-resistant against weather and physical impact.
statement_json.budget: ₹6,00,000 covering 100 smart bin sensors, 15 vehicle telematics units, and cloud routing engine.
statement_json.expected_outcomes: 30% reduction in fleet fuel consumption and near-elimination of uncollected overflowing community bins.
statement_json.kpis: Overflow incidents < 15/week; fuel <= 9.5 L/ton; route adherence >= 92%; ward coverage >= 15 wards.
statement_json.eligibility_requirements: DPIIT-recognized cleantech/IoT startup with ISO 9001:2015 certification and at least 1 year operational experience.
statement_json.data_requirements: Real-time bin fill percentage feeds, GPS vehicle track coordinates, and fuel consumption logs.
statement_json.security_requirements: Secure vehicle telemetry transmission and authenticated supervisory dashboard access.
